name: MediQ
description: MediQ is an interactive benchmark designed to evaluate large language models' ability to ask clarifying questions and reliably perform clinical reasoning in multi-turn interactions. It simulates clinical scenarios where initial patient information may be incomplete, requiring models to proactively seek missing details before making diagnostic decisions.
reputation: A new interactive clinical reasoning benchmark that is still emerging and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: Focuses on interactive question-asking ability in clinical reasoning; converts single-turn medical benchmarks into interactive format; highlights challenges in adapting LLMs to proactive information-seeking.
